spans.s:
m. (-भः)
A demon slain by VIṢṆU.
f. (-भा)
A name of DURGĀ.
E.
कैटभ a demon in whose death the goddess was instrumental, by having at the prayers of BRAHMĀ roused VIṢṆU from his slumbers, during which two demons, Kaitabha and Madhu, were about to demolish BRAHMĀ; also कैटभी.

m. (-जित्)
A name of VIṢṆU.
E.
कैटभ the name of an Asura killed by the deity, and जित् who conquers; also similar compounds, as कैटभहन्, &c.

m. (-रिः)
A name of VIṢṆU: see कैटभजित्.

m. (-र्य्यः)
A plant used in medicine, commonly

The Nimb tree.
3 Mayana, (Vangueria spinosa.)
E.
कैटर from किट to fear, and रा to cause, alarming by its pungency; pleonastic affix ष्यञ्; also कैडर्य्य.
